plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the WeaveAPI docs system, focusing on the primary docs flow (Quickstart → API references) and adjacent pages/states, including mobile viewport checks.
plan.summary: Start with the home page (index.html) to explore core sections, then move to Quickstart (quickstart.html) for the tutorial flow. Next, dive into API reference pages (charges.html, customers.html, webhooks.html, errors.html) to validate content structure, interactables, and mobile responsiveness. Prioritize the 'try-it' panels on charges.html and check error handling guidance.
assumptions: All HTML pages load without errors (per prescan)
The 'try-it' panel on charges.html is interactive and returns mock responses
Left nav links are consistent across pages
risk_hotspots: small tap targets on left nav (mobile usability)
error code examples (consistency with API responses)

phases.title: Home Page & Core Navigation
phases.objective: Validate home page structure, navigation links, and initial interactables (search, theme toggle).
key_checks: Click left nav links (Quickstart, Charges, Customers) to verify navigation
Interact with search input and theme toggle
Check mobile viewport for navigation responsiveness
exit_criteria: All major nav links are clickable and load correct pages
Search and theme toggle are functional
Mobile navigation is usable (tap targets, layout)

phases.title: Quickstart Tutorial Flow
phases.objective: Explore the Quickstart guide to validate tutorial clarity, code examples, and adjacent links.
key_checks: Follow Quickstart steps (install SDK, first charge example)
Verify code block interactivity (copy button, language tabs)
Check links to Charges API reference
Validate mobile viewport for code readability
exit_criteria: Quickstart steps are clear and code examples are copyable
Links to API references are functional
Mobile code blocks are readable (no overflow)

phases.title: Charges API Reference
phases.objective: Deep-dive Charges API page: validate object schema, endpoint sections, and 'try-it' panel interaction.
key_checks: Interact with 'try-it' panel (fill params, send request, check mock response)
Validate endpoint sections (Create, Retrieve, Capture, Refund, List)
Check mobile viewport for table readability and panel interaction
exit_criteria: Charge object schema is complete and accurate
'try-it' panel returns correct mock responses (valid/invalid currency)
Endpoint sections have clear parameters and code examples

phases.title: API Reference Pages (Customers, Webhooks, Errors)
phases.objective: Validate API reference pages (Customers, Webhooks, Errors) for content structure, interactables, and error guidance.
key_checks: Check Customer object schema and endpoint sections (Create, Retrieve, Update, Delete)
Verify error code examples and HTTP status mapping
Explore Webhooks event types and signature verification guidance
Validate mobile viewport for table readability (e.g., Charge/Customer object tables)
exit_criteria: Customer API reference is complete (object schema, endpoints)
Error codes are consistent with API behavior (e.g., card_declined, insufficient_funds)
Webhooks documentation includes event types and verification steps

phases.title: Mobile Usability & Edge Cases
phases.objective: Re-validate critical pages in mobile viewport, focusing on small tap targets, code blocks, and error recovery paths.
key_checks: Re-test left nav tap targets (mobile guidance compliance)
Verify code block readability and copy functionality on mobile
Check error handling guidance (errors.html) for mobile accessibility
Re-interact with charges.html try-it panel on mobile
exit_criteria: Mobile tap targets are usable (≥44px or have sufficient spacing)
Code blocks are readable and copyable on mobile
Error guidance is accessible on mobile
Try-it panel is functional on mobile

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 6 known HTML pages (index, quickstart, charges, customers, errors, webhooks)
coverage_targets.features: Exercise left nav, search, theme toggle, code copy, 'try-it' panel (charges.html), and all major API endpoint sections
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (navigation, interactables, code readability) on mobile viewport for at least 3 key pages (index, quickstart, charges)

notes: Prioritize 'try-it' panel interaction on charges.html to validate parameter handling (e.g., currency=usd vs invalid).
Check for horizontal overflow in tables/code blocks on mobile.

prescan_summary.title: WeaveAPI — Threads of value, woven simple
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https:
headings: Accept your first payment in 5 minutes.

prescan_summary.title: Errors — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Error codes All WeaveAPI errors are returned as a structured object. Use code for programmatic handling and message for display. CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url

prescan_summary.title: Webhooks — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.
